summary: This component displays a grid of blog posts related to the current post, either by a designated main tag or by shared tags. It retrieves the current post's metadata and tag information, fetches matching related posts through a helper hook, and renders them as cards, with fallback handling for when no related posts exist.

explanations.41: The frontMatter object comes from Docusaurus, which doesn't know about your custom mainTag field, so TypeScript types it as unknown. We cast it to string | undefined to tell TypeScript what we expect.
explanations.42: We're safely extracting the tags array from frontMatter with a fallback to an empty array, so tags will always be an array even if frontMatter doesn't have tags defined.
explanations.46: This hook must be called at the top level (before any early returns) because React hooks have strict ordering rules—we can't call hooks conditionally or after returns.
explanations.53: If there's no mainTag and no tags at all, there's no criteria to find related posts, so we return null to render nothing instead of showing an empty state.
explanations.75: When description is false, we spread the post object but override its description to null, effectively hiding descriptions without modifying the original post data.
